_readme: Hook bank (Roland, 28 Oct 2026). Every Reel/Short gets 3 hook versions tagged by style; 'used' is the one cut into the video with studio/hookcut.py. 'caption_start' = first 40 chars of the reel caption, so scripts/research.py can match Instagram posts and rank styles by average watch time (research/<date>.json -> hook_scoreboard). Styles: stake, mistake, number, myth, warning, curiosity, nigeria. Rules: 7 words or fewer, the voice says the same promise, the video pays it off.
